objective: Test whether one model-directed union of coding-native and legal-structural retrieval can beat pinned upstream Mike on Harvey LAB accuracy without a benchmark-shaped task router.

routing_policy.model_choice: After Glob reports filenames plus extracted character and line counts, the model may use complete fetch_documents reads, targeted Grep and bounded Read, or a mixed strategy.
routing_policy.accuracy_default: When completeness is uncertain and the bounded source set fits, prefer complete coverage.
routing_policy.host_role: Deduplicate repeated document/version reads, retain an exact evidence union for drafting handoff, and run deterministic post-synthesis checks. The host does not choose a route from task wording.

held_constant.split: visible Harvey LAB development tasks only

matrix.shape: five-source template, redline, playbook, and context comparison
nine-source legal and factual strategy synthesis
fourteen-source precedent-led instrument drafting plus issues memo

baseline_policy.reuse: Reuse an existing score only when it used pinned upstream Mike, gpt-5.6-luna, high effort, requested fast, and reported priority.
baseline_policy.candidate_runs: Run coverage_finalist once on every matrix task before changing the arm.

primary_accuracy_gate.judge: The same fixed LAB evaluator and judge model used for both fresh candidate and fresh upstream cells; existing reused upstream scores must have the same judge model.
primary_accuracy_gate.win: The candidate must exceed upstream Mike in both total criteria passed across the paired matrix and unweighted mean per-task pass rate. A tie is not a win.
primary_accuracy_gate.regression_guard: The candidate may not trail upstream by more than five percentage points on more than one task.
primary_accuracy_gate.efficiency: Tokens, cache use, tool calls, source exposure, and latency are secondary diagnostics and cannot compensate for lower accuracy.

trace_questions: Did the model choose complete, targeted, or mixed retrieval from the same neutral surface?
Were every relevant source and primary drafting scaffold exposed before synthesis?
Did exact evidence handoff preserve or discard facts needed by failed criteria?
Were failures retrieval misses, synthesis/attention misses, mutation defects, compiler regressions, or judge noise?
How much source text and duplicate context did the candidate expose relative to upstream?
failure_policy: If the frozen candidate loses, do not reinterpret efficiency as success. Classify failures, make only task-independent correctness changes justified by traces, preregister a new version, and rerun affected plus sentinel tasks.
